draft.shortGloss: to pull; to drag; to stretch
draft.emotion: focused and firm, putting physical effort into moving an object
notes: The opposite of 'kéo' (to pull) is 'đẩy' (to push). It is also a homonym of the noun 'kéo' (scissors).
Often combines with 'dài' (long) to form 'kéo dài' (to last, to prolong, to extend in time).
